assumptions.statement: The submitted overall polygon is provisional rough geometry, not an official redline.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, positions, figures, and boards are non-statutory and must be recomputed.
assumptions.resolution: Replace it with cleared official GeoJSON/CAD-derived geometry and rerun the deterministic builder.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional task frames and are not parcels or station catchments.
assumptions.impact: They support differentiated concept roles only; they cannot support siting, ownership, or precise-area conclusions.
assumptions.resolution: Replace all three after official polygons and on-site interfaces are verified.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, green ratio, setback, road redlines, parking, heritage controls, and municipal capacity are not available.
assumptions.impact: Statutory and engineering values remain unknown; no permanent building or infrastructure conclusion is made.
assumptions.resolution: Qualified planning and engineering teams review official controls and surveys.

assumptions.statement: Submitted building polygons are conceptual carrier envelopes, not measured existing buildings or demolition decisions.
assumptions.impact: No retain-renovate-demolish, structural, fire, ownership, or capacity conclusion may be inferred.
assumptions.resolution: Verify current use, ownership, structure, fire, accessibility, heritage, noise, and operating responsibility before any activation.

assumptions.statement: All operator, host, assessor, service-provider, and event roles are proposed responsibility slots.
assumptions.impact: No government, enterprise, venue, school, community, health, or social-work commitment is implied.
assumptions.resolution: Each accountable and responsible role accepts a written scope, budget, complaint path, stop rule, and handback duty.

assumptions.statement: No cleared project-area dataset establishes loneliness, social isolation, desired connection, face-to-face time, or companion-AI effect.
assumptions.impact: WHO and national time-use statistics remain background; no Haidian prevalence or outcome claim is made.
assumptions.resolution: An independent qualified team designs an ethics-reviewed, voluntary, stratified local baseline with declared sampling limits.

assumptions.statement: Any use of standardized loneliness or social-connection instruments, delayed follow-up, minors, or sensitive disclosures requires separate ethics and professional review.
assumptions.impact: This package defines spatial and governance gates but does not select a clinical instrument, diagnose people, or create health records.
assumptions.resolution: A qualified research sponsor documents legal basis, consent, safeguarding, protocol, retention, withdrawal, adverse-event handling, and publication rules.

assumptions.statement: Human handoff directories, response times, accessibility, languages, and emergency routes are not yet verified for a real pilot.
assumptions.impact: No product may claim a working human handoff from a concept directory.
assumptions.resolution: Named service owners test every channel, schedule, escalation rule, offline equivalent, and failure response before opening.

assumptions.statement: The human-first spine and connectors express continuity questions, not new road, rail, bridge, tunnel, or station alignments.
assumptions.impact: No safe route, station quadrant, operating railway interface, or step-free access may be inferred.
assumptions.resolution: Perform field, transport, rail, ownership, lighting, fire, and accessibility review before publishing a route.

assumptions.statement: Capital cost, operating cost, procurement, insurance, staffing, funding, and development timing have not been estimated.
assumptions.impact: No fiscal, investment, procurement, or delivery commitment is claimed.
assumptions.resolution: Prepare independent scope, quantities, operating plan, funding plan, and approvals after sites and operators are confirmed.
